description: Seed artists for the vertical-slice sample graph. Chosen to span hip-hop, R&B, pop, jazz, electronic and rock so that cross-genre paths and bridge artists exist. Names are resolved to MusicBrainz IDs by `songnexus fetch`; pin `mbid` when the resolver reports an ambiguous name. Every pinned mbid carries a pin_reason recording the human decision.
